item.title: Has a pool! Circa 1900 in Illinois. $285,000
item.description: Neat idea for an above ground pool! Pretty house with a great porch! This is a big house with almost 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1900. It is located in Fairfield, Illinois. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, pocket doors, leaded glass transom window, baseboards and a grand staircase. There is a large above ground pool with a bar area. The property has a detached garage. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,983 square feet. $285,000 Contact Katie Matthews

item.title: Beautiful staircase! Circa 1890 in Indiana. $289,900
item.description: This house has a beautiful staircase inside! Pretty woodwork too. The house was built in 1890. It is located on .25 acre in Auburn, Indiana. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, french doors, baseboards, beautiful front door with leaded glass, grand staircase, wainscoting, vintage light fixtures, great kitchen sink and exposed brick. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,132 square feet. $289,900 Contact Michelle Snyder with North Eastern Realty Group: 260-615-6289 From the Zillow

item.title: Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! The Saban Estate. $4,995,000
item.description: Welcome to Louisiana’s most expensive old house listing! Known as the Saban Estate, It was built in 1953. It is located on 5.38 acres in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. I love the grounds of this property. There is a beautiful pool, pretty gardens and mature landscaping. There is a lighted sports court and a resort style in-ground pool. item.title: Storybook house! Circa 1920 in Kansas. $299,900
item.description: This house looks like a storybook house! Like a miniature castle! The house was built in 1920. It is located in Topeka, Kansas. The house features an arched entryway, wood floors, a small covered side porch, crown moulding, baseboards, french doors, built-in bookshelves, nice staircase, built-in corner cabinet, spacious kitchen and vaulted ceiling. There is a large basement and a detached garage. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,801 square feet. $299,900 Contact Annette Harper with Coldwell B

item.title: Potential! Circa 1930. Over 4,000 square feet in Louisiana. $549,900
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! It’s a large house with over 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1930. It is located on .4 acre in Marrero, Louisiana. The house is a neoclassical house with Mediterranean details. The house features a loggia across the front of the house, grand staircase, wood floors, baseboards, vintage light fixtures, sunroom and a spacious kitchen. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,139 square feet. $549,900 Contact Alison Romaguera with WayMaker Realty: 504-258-8878

item.title: Wasn’t expecting that interior! Circa 1868 in Maine. $1,100,000
item.description: Wow! Sure wasn’t expecting that interior! Such a beautiful home! Absolutely in love with the sitting area in the belvedere! This home is known as the Francis Peabody House. The house was built in 1868. It is located in Portland, Maine. The house features a mansard roof, belvedere/widow’s walk, grand staircase, wood floors, beautiful crown moulding, tall ceilings, vintage light fixtures, ceiling medallions, built-ins and an updated kitchen. item.title: Maine’s most expensive old house listing! Harbor Watch, Circa 1900. $9,998,000
item.description: Welcome to Maine’s most expensive old house listing! Known as Harbor Watch. It was built in 1900. It is located on 2.2 acres in Kennebunkport, Maine. The property has beautiful grounds with landscaped gardens and a pretty in-ground pool. There are views of Kennebunk River and the Atlantic Ocean beyond. There is a large custom bar and pretty areas for entertaining. Five bedrooms, nine bathrooms and 12,612 square feet. $9,998,000 From the Zillow listing: Welcome to Harbor Watch-a distinguished est

item.title: Cute log cabin! Almost two acres in Maryland. $285,000
item.description: This is a cute log cabin. Could use some undoing of past renovations, but this has a lot of potential. The house was built in 1953. It is located on 1.86 acres in Smithsburg, Maryland. The cabin features a covered front porch, wood floors, brick fireplace and some knotty pine. item.description: Take a look inside this building in Massachusetts. Sure wasn’t expecting that! The building was constructed in 1850. It is located in Pittsfield, Massachusetts. item.title: $150,000! Pretty staircase! 6 beds/4 baths in Michigan.
item.description: Nice staircase! This is a big house with 6 beds and 4 baths! Wish the pictures were better! The house was built in 1920. It is located in Port Huron, Michigan. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, baseboards, wainscoting a large attic and a large basement.
